cell wall composition and structure, as well as cell wall response to pretreatment, is highly variable and dependent on anatomical fraction and plant tissue maturity within a single plant species.

the composition and organization of cell wall polysaccharides is an important contributor to cell wall heterogeneity and recalcitrance, and that the relative abundance of non-cellulosic polysacharides (e.g., glucuronoarabinosyl xylans, pectins) may be a useful indicator of recalcitrance within a single plant.
